evals.name: bare-invocation-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.expected_output: Runs check.py with --data-dir, reports its PASS/FAIL rows and summary as printed, and changes nothing.

evals.name: install-model-downloads-then-reports-observed-state
evals.expected_output: Runs assets.py fetch with --data-dir, reports the asset folder or the error, then runs check and reports its rows as the observed state.

Does not install espeak-ng or the Python packages

Also install espeak-ng for me while you're at it.
